prompt: Draw a flowchart for a simple user login process.
expected: A Mermaid flowchart representing a user login process including start, decision point (valid credentials), and end.
actual:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Start] --> B{Valid Credentials?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Login Successful]
    B -->|No| D[Show Error]
    C --> E[End]
    D --> E
```

prompt: Show the architecture of a typical 3-tier web app using Mermaid.
expected: A Mermaid flowchart or C4 diagram containing subgraphs or distinct nodes for Client, Web Server/App Server, and Database.
actual:
```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Client Tier
        A[Web Browser]
    end
    subgraph Application Tier
        B[Web Server]
        C[Application Server]
    end
    subgraph Data Tier
        D[(Database)]
    end
    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
```
